approved: National Disability Insurance Scheme Legislation Amendment Bill 2013
Families, Housing, Community Services and Indigenous Affairs

Moved to suspend standing orders so debate on the Medicare Levy Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill 2013, 11 related bills, and the National Disability Insurance Scheme Legislation Amendment Bill 2013 could resume at a later hour.

Moved to suspend standing orders so that 14 bills related to DisabilityCare Australia (the National Disability Insurance Scheme) could be considered during the current sitting period; the motion was agreed to.

The government argued for increasing the Medicare levy from 1.5% to 2% from July 2014 to fund DisabilityCare Australia, and announced the establishment of the DisabilityCare Australia Fund and technical amendments to the NDIS Act. The scheme will roll out from July 2013 in launch sites
